title: PlanetScale MCP Server
summary: Inspect PlanetScale databases and branches from your agent, run read queries, check schema and review performance insights over OAuth.
description: PlanetScale hosts an MCP server that covers organizations, databases and branches. The agent can read a branch's schema, run read queries, pull query insights, list schema recommendations and search the PlanetScale documentation.

You sign in with OAuth and choose, per organization or database, whether the grant is none, read-only or full. Pick read-only for everyday work. The read query tool accepts only SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE and EXPLAIN, and reads go to a replica when one exists. PlanetScale also offers an insights-only endpoint with no query tools at all.
useWhen: Compare the schema of a branch with production
Ask which queries are slowest and what indexes are suggested
Check error patterns in recent queries
Look up a PlanetScale feature without leaving the editor

mcp.name: planetscale
access: Reads organizations, databases, branches and schema you grant
Runs read queries; write queries only if you grant full access
Can read billing information if you allow it

example.prompt: Show the schema of the main branch of the shop database and flag any table without a primary key.
example.result: 12 tables on main. The table session_events has no primary key; the other 11 do. Suggested fix: add an auto-increment id.

faq.question: How do I keep it read-only?
faq.answer: Choose read-only in the OAuth prompt, or use the insights-only endpoint, which leaves out both query tools.

faq.question: Can I use it in CI?
faq.answer: PlanetScale offers an MCP service token for headless agents. Its access level is set on the token.

faq.question: Does it protect against bad writes?
faq.answer: With write access, UPDATE and DELETE without WHERE and TRUNCATE are blocked, and schema changes ask for confirmation.
